intent.subject: the uppercase initials FDI constructed from colorful interlocking toy bricks

visual_summary.description: A wide, front-facing illustration of the uppercase letters F, D, and I assembled from red, yellow, blue, and pale gray interlocking toy construction bricks. The letters stand on a long light-gray studded baseplate. The drawing uses heavy black outlines, subtle irregularities, and lightly shaded brick studs on a fully transparent background.
visual_summary.text_realization: three-dimensional brick-built letter sculptures rather than printed typography

appearance.top_surface: light cool gray with a dense regular grid of cylindrical studs
appearance.perspective: top surface visible as a shallow trapezoid

structure.silhouette: tall block-capital F with a wide top arm, shorter middle arm, and thick vertical stem
structure.top_arm: long red-orange horizontal course with six visible top studs
structure.middle_arm: blue horizontal projection with two prominent top studs
structure.negative_spaces: transparent openings to the right of the stem beneath the top and middle arms

structure.silhouette: large block-capital D with a straight left spine, stepped top and right outer curve, broad bottom foot, and a large transparent inner counter
structure.top_arch: blue at upper left transitioning through red-orange stepped bricks toward upper right
structure.right_curve: stepped red-orange, yellow, blue, and pale gray bricks
structure.inner_counter: large transparent rounded-rectangular opening edged by stepped brick courses
structure.inner_lower_edge: small visible pale-gray and yellow studs emphasize the curve

structure.silhouette: narrow rectangular block-capital I represented as a straight vertical tower
structure.top_course: blue cap with three prominent studs

spatial_relationships.description: F and D are separated by a moderate transparent gap; D and I are separated by a narrower but clear transparent gap.
All three letters terminate near the same upper surface of the baseplate.

composition.framing: wide full-object view with minimal outer padding
composition.camera_angle: near-frontal with a slight elevated view that reveals top studs and upper brick surfaces
composition.camera_height: slightly above the vertical center of the letters
composition.visual_balance: three large letter masses distributed across the width; the broad F and D balance the narrow I with extra right-side baseplate area
composition.subject_scale: letters occupy roughly 80 percent of canvas height
composition.negative_space: transparent canvas around the assembly and within the open regions of F and D

style.visual_language: comic-style drawing of three-dimensional plastic construction bricks

linework.usage: all silhouettes, brick seams, studs, and depth edges

style.surface_rendering: flat color fills with restrained cel-shading and subtle edge highlights
style.geometry: chunky modular rectangular bricks with cylindrical studs

core_colors.name: pale cool gray
core_colors.role: letter courses, studs, and baseplate top

color_palette.saturation: high on primary brick colors; low on gray elements
color_palette.contrast: high due to black outlines and saturated fills

bricks.stud_shape: short cylindrical studs with elliptical top faces under perspective
bricks.surface_detail: clean and simplified; no logos or molded text

lighting.highlights: small muted highlights on the upper faces of studs
lighting.shadows: minimal local cel-shading; no cast shadow on a background

rendering.edge_treatment: antialiased black contours with occasional sketch-like irregularity
rendering.texture: very subtle painterly or scanned-line variation

must_include: exactly three uppercase brick-built letters in the order F, D, I
red-orange, yellow, blue, and pale-gray brick courses
thick black outlines around every brick, seam, stud, and silhouette
large transparent inner counter in D
must_preserve: exact output dimensions of 1280 by 600 pixels
relative widths: F broad, D broadest, I narrow
avoid: logos or brand marks on studs
people, hands, scenery, floor, wall, or sky
cropping of the baseplate or letters
misreading the D as O or zero

generation_directive.instruction: Generate an image strictly from this AJCP as an RGBA PNG measuring exactly 1280 by 600 pixels. Reconstruct the composition as a transparent PNG. Do not add, remove, rename, or reorder elements. Treat FDI as physical sculptures assembled from individually outlined interlocking toy bricks, not as printed text.
priority_order: transparent background and internal negative spaces

analysis_notes.schema_note: AJCP is a loosely structured prompting convention rather than an official standardized schema; this profile uses a reproducibility-oriented descriptive structure.
analysis_notes.measurement_note: Pixel dimensions, file properties, alpha counts, and core solid colors were measured from the source image. Subject bounding boxes and geometric descriptions are visual estimates.
uncertainty: Individual brick dimensions and stud counts vary due to perspective and stylized drawing.
Minor highlight and shadow hues are represented as tonal variations of the listed core colors.
